tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The desk: app background behind flush panels, page gutters. Never text on it smaller than ink-3.

tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: Node canvas ground (Editor, Replay), under canvas-dot. In dark it is the deepest plane: things closer to you get lighter.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Flush panels, tables, node cards, inputs. The chart surface the palettes were validated on (#ffffff / #1e2125).

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Hover wash on rows, list items and quiet buttons; the track of a segmented control.

tokens.name: surface-3
tokens.usage: Pressed state, selected table row, the thumb well of a progress track.

tokens.name: layer
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: popover, menu, tooltip, toast, the floating inspector over the canvas. Always paired with shadow-float.

tokens.name: seg-thumb
tokens.usage: The pressed thumb of a segmented control: surface in light, line-strong in dark, so it reads as raised above its surface-3 track in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between flush panels, table rows, list items. Decorative separation only (not a control boundary).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Node card border at rest, chart axis/baseline, edge stroke at rest, dividers that group (a metric group in a table).

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Boundary of an input, select, checkbox and secondary button: 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: canvas-dot
tokens.usage: Dots of the canvas grid (1px every 16px). Major dots every 128px use line-strong.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numbers on ground, canvas, surface, surface-2/3 and layer (15:1+ light, 11:1+ dark).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, impl names, table body in dense views, on every ground and surface (7:1+).

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Muted text: captions, axis ticks, timestamps, placeholders; 4.5:1+ on ground, canvas, surface and surface-3 in both themes. Never for a value someone must read to decide.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast by WCAG; always paired with a reason nearby).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: THE accent, graphite slate. Primary button fill, selected node ring, active tab mark, focus ring, rank-strip hits. One per view carries the emphasis. 11:1+ on every ground in both themes.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of an accent fill (primary button).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-wash
tokens.usage: Selection halo around a selected node, selected-row tint, drop-target wash. Never behind body text that is not ink.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring at 2px offset, outside the element. Alias of accent, so it clears 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: family-retriever
tokens.usage: Node family slot 1: bm25, dense, remote retrievers. Pigment register: glyph tile on node cards, palette section marks, latency-stack segments. Relief rule: always beside the family glyph and a text label.

tokens.name: family-fusion
tokens.usage: Node family slot 2: rrf and other merges. Pigment register: glyph tile on node cards, palette section marks, latency-stack segments. Relief rule: always beside the family glyph and a text label.

tokens.name: family-reranker
tokens.usage: Node family slot 3: cross-encoders, onnx rerankers. Pigment register: glyph tile on node cards, palette section marks, latency-stack segments. Relief rule: always beside the family glyph and a text label.

tokens.name: family-context
tokens.usage: Node family slot 4: context builders (concat, windowing). Pigment register: glyph tile on node cards, palette section marks, latency-stack segments. Relief rule: always beside the family glyph and a text label.

tokens.name: family-generator
tokens.usage: Node family slot 5: LLM generators, local or Remote. Pigment register: glyph tile on node cards, palette section marks, latency-stack segments. Relief rule: always beside the family glyph and a text label.

tokens.name: family-judge
tokens.usage: Node family slot 6: the LLM-as-judge grader (reserved; arrives with the judge). Pigment register: glyph tile on node cards, palette section marks, latency-stack segments. Relief rule: always beside the family glyph and a text label.

tokens.name: family-query
tokens.usage: Neutral family for the query input node and, later, control-flow nodes (branch, loop), which are told apart by shape, not hue.

tokens.name: on-family
tokens.usage: Glyph ink on a family tile: 5:1+ on every light pigment, 3:1+ on every dark pigment.

tokens.name: run-base
tokens.usage: The baseline run of a comparison, always neutral and always first. In charts it is the reference the others are read against.

tokens.name: run-a
tokens.usage: Candidate run A (comparison slot 2). Ink register: bars, 2px lines, swatches. Assigned by slot when runs are selected, kept for the session; always shown with its letter.

tokens.name: run-b
tokens.usage: Candidate run B (comparison slot 3). Ink register: bars, 2px lines, swatches. Assigned by slot when runs are selected, kept for the session; always shown with its letter.

tokens.name: run-c
tokens.usage: Candidate run C (comparison slot 4). Ink register: bars, 2px lines, swatches. Assigned by slot when runs are selected, kept for the session; always shown with its letter.

tokens.name: run-d
tokens.usage: Candidate run D (comparison slot 5). Ink register: bars, 2px lines, swatches. Assigned by slot when runs are selected, kept for the session; always shown with its letter.

tokens.name: on-run
tokens.usage: Letter on a run swatch for runs A, C and D (4.5:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: on-run-b
tokens.usage: Letter on the run B swatch: the gold needs dark ink in both themes.

tokens.name: better
tokens.usage: A delta that improves on the baseline (higher nDCG, lower latency): delta text, the right arm of the per-query histogram. Always with a sign and an arrow glyph.

tokens.name: worse
tokens.usage: A delta that regresses against the baseline: delta text, the left arm of the histogram. Always with a sign and an arrow glyph.

tokens.name: delta-zero
tokens.usage: The neutral midpoint of the diverging histogram (unchanged queries).

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Status good: done, connected, verified digest. Icon plus word, never color alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Status warning fill and icon (running slower than usual, a digest not yet verified). As text use warning-ink.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text on surface and ground (5:1+).

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Status critical: failed run, node error, unreachable service, refused edge. Icon plus word; as text 4.7:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: good-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a good status chip.

tokens.name: warning-wash
tokens.usage: Background of a warning status chip or inline warning.

tokens.name: critical-wash
tokens.usage: Background of an inline error, an erroring node body, a critical chip.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a modal sheet (rare: undo beats confirm).

families.display: "Wix Madefor Display", "Wix Madefor Text", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.sans: "Wix Madefor Text", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Wix Madefor Display, the optical size for 17px and up. Tight tracking, set sparingly.

styles.name: type-cover
styles.usage: The wordmark set in type (no logo yet). Cover and splash only.

styles.name: type-title
styles.usage: One per screen: the screen title, phrased as what the screen shows.

styles.name: type-verdict
styles.sample: hybrid-rerank answers 29 more queries at rank 1, for 351 ms more per query.
styles.usage: The verdict sentence that ends a comparison or a launch (peak-end rule). One per view.

styles.name: type-figure
styles.usage: The one best metric of a view (Von Restorff). Tabular figures.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Wix Madefor Text, drawn for 11 to 16px UI. Tabular figures on everywhere numbers align.

styles.name: type-heading
styles.sample: nDCG@10 at the output of each node
styles.usage: Panel and section headings, inspector title.

styles.name: type-body
styles.sample: A run is one pipeline on one benchmark.
styles.usage: Default UI text, descriptions, form values.

styles.name: type-dense
styles.usage: Tables, run rows, node card body, lists: the working size of the product.

styles.name: type-label
styles.usage: Field labels, chip text, legend entries, column headers. Sentence case, never tracked capitals.

styles.name: type-caption
styles.sample: read from the traces, not from a separate run
styles.usage: Captions under charts, helper text under fields (ink-3).

styles.name: type-micro
styles.usage: Axis ticks, port labels. The floor: nothing smaller.

groups.name: Mono
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono: 0/O, 1/l/I and 5/S are unmistakable, so a hash read off the screen survives being retyped into an issue.

styles.name: type-mono
styles.usage: Parameters, YAML, paths, component ids in body text.

styles.name: type-hash
styles.usage: Run hashes (6 chars shown, full on hover and copy), digests, query ids.

spacing.note: A 4px grid. Every padding, gap and offset is one of these.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked segments and adjacent bars (the surface gap); rank-strip cell gap.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside a chip; port to port label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding x; gap in a toolbar group; table cell padding y (dense).

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button padding x; node card padding; table cell padding x.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between form rows; page gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between a panel heading and its content block.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels in a grid; page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between screen header and content.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state padding; section rhythm in long pages (Setup).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Horizontal distance between node columns on the canvas (auto-layout).

radius.note: Concentric: a shape nested inside another takes the outer radius minus the inset between them.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Rank-strip cells, bar data-ends, table selection marks.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, chips, segmented-control thumb, family glyph tile.

tokens.name: radius-track
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track and grouped control rails: radius-s plus the 2px inset, so the thumb nests concentrically.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Node cards, content sheets, popovers, menus, tooltips, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Floating inspector over the canvas, modal sheet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status chips and filter pills only; ports.

shadow.note: Depth means "this object is above the page". Flush panels have none. Node cards (movable objects) get contact; floating layers get float.

tokens.name: shadow-contact
tokens.usage: Node cards at rest on the canvas. The only resting object with a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A node while dragged; a palette item while dragged onto the canvas.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Popover, menu, tooltip, toast, floating inspector. Paired with layer.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modal sheet over scrim. Rare.

size.note: Fixed dimensions of controls and canvas geometry.

tokens.name: size-control-s
tokens.usage: Chips, compact icon buttons inside dense tables (the hit area is padded to 32px).

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default button, input, select, segmented control, tab (Fitts floor).

tokens.name: size-control-l
tokens.usage: The one primary action of a launch or empty state.

tokens.name: size-topbar
tokens.usage: Top bar height.

tokens.name: size-inspector
tokens.usage: Inspector / side panel width.

tokens.name: size-grid
tokens.usage: Canvas grid pitch; nodes snap to it.

tokens.name: size-grid-major
tokens.usage: Major grid dot pitch (line-strong dots).

tokens.name: size-node
tokens.usage: Node card width (14 grid units).

tokens.name: size-port
tokens.usage: Port diameter; its hit target is 24px.

tokens.name: size-rank-cell
tokens.usage: One rank-strip cell (10 cells + gaps = 98px).

duration.note: Motion answers an action and shows what changed. Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration except duration-0 becomes 1ms and nothing travels.

tokens.name: duration-0
tokens.usage: Hover color changes: immediate, like a native control.

tokens.name: duration-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state in and out.

tokens.name: duration-micro
tokens.usage: Checkbox, toggle, chip selection, segmented thumb, tooltip in.

tokens.name: duration-standard
tokens.usage: Inspector slide, tab content cross-fade, row expand.

tokens.name: duration-emphasis
tokens.usage: Canvas pan and zoom to a node, sheet in, a refused edge snapping back.

tokens.name: duration-data
tokens.usage: A chart re-laying out when its data changes (never on first paint).

easing.note: Decelerate into rest; nothing bounces except a snap.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Most transitions: fast start, long settle.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Things leaving (toast out, menu close).

tokens.name: ease-snap
tokens.usage: A node snapping to the grid, an edge connecting to a port: a 4% overshoot, once.
